justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java-gradle-api/org/gradle/api/file/Directory.java`, `DirectoryProperty.java`, `package-info.java`, and `byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/src/main/java-gradle-api/org/gradle/api/provider/Provider.java`. The target package is a small compatibility shim: `Directory` only depends on `java.io.File`; `DirectoryProperty` depends on `org.gradle.api.provider.Provider`, `java.io.File`, and `FileTree`; `package-info.java` says it is a substitution package for legacy compilation. In the repo, 12 other source files import `org.gradle.api.file` types (for example `ByteBuddyTask.java`, `ByteBuddyTaskConfiguration.java`, `ByteBuddyPlugin.java`, `InputChanges.java`, and `ByteBuddyTaskExtensionTest.java`), so the package has high fan-in and only minimal fan-out. That does not indicate an unstable dependency smell.
